integrity: An analytic proof is supplied and a finite numerical checker supplements but does not replace it.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic autonomous two-species model; positive parameters and initial data; strictly monotone conversion R (\(B>\xi\)); exact predator-invasion equality; pointwise in fixed exponent \(1<p\le2\). title: Critical extinction resonance in generalized predator competition
